items.title: See what changed before you update
items.body: When an update is ready, this screen now lists every new feature and fix, in plain words, before you tap Update now. If you missed earlier updates, you see those changes too.

releases.title: Streams, albums and a cleaner Home

items.title: A welcome that matches the website
items.body: Every Home now opens with a banner that greets you by time of day, rotates its greeting, and shows your name in the Connekyt blue to pink colours.

items.title: Streams work like the dashboard
items.body: Totals for streams, viewers, chat messages and video messages. Search your streams, filter by event type, read the chat of any stream, watch viewers' video messages with new ones marked, and delete a stream record after confirming.

items.title: Album photos and covers load again
items.body: Photos and covers in your albums, including paid albums and file names with spaces, now appear instead of grey boxes.

items.title: Smoother scrolling, no empty space
items.body: Screens no longer leave a large empty band at the end of a list, and the public event page and Explore Events render with less lag.

items.title: Real figures, no guesses
items.body: Donation amounts, currencies, event categories and photographer specialties now come from our servers instead of fixed lists. If a figure cannot be loaded, the app says so instead of showing zero.

items.title: A clearer Event Ended screen
items.body: When an event is over, you get the event photo, a short explanation and two clear buttons: Find my photos and View event details.
